items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Argus. I'm going to be with Joseph Argus.

ctx.x: Yeah, he didn't. He was with the central there. Up near Donaldsonville, in Central, I think. I'm not sure, but I get all confused. I don't get out that much. I said I don't know how to forget about the police here. Yeah. Because after my mother died, I don't know how to do that.
What was your name before you married? Argus. I'm going to be with Joseph Argus.
I'm sorry. Hey there, well, I'll regret. All right, that's my grandson. I'm going to be with you. I'm going to be with you.
